definitions.primary_scope: Original whole-experiment cgroup CPU including simulator, frontend, planner, mission and launch helpers; observer/background excluded
definitions.primary_mean_cores: Original end_to_end_cpu_cores_mean, preserved without recomputation or subtraction
definitions.additional_scope: Instrumented functional exclusive-stage subtotal, excluding measured simulator and diagnostic/visualization stages; NOT complete autonomy CPU
definitions.additional_core_s: Sum of end-minus-start exclusive_cpu_s counters in the functional category over common report boundaries within observed flight
definitions.additional_mean_cores: Additional profile-window CPU core-s divided by that exact profile duration, then arithmetic mean across runs

categories.precedence: Exact simulator, then exact diagnostic, then functional prefix, otherwise unclassified

definitions.missing: Unavailable stage/counter/bucket values are null in JSON and blank in CSV, not invented zero. A first absent cumulative counter uses the existing analyzer zero-baseline rule and is flagged separately.
definitions.inactive: Absence of a function stage does not establish zero CPU for an uninstrumented function. Full has no frontend component; unused callbacks may produce no records.
definitions.reductions: Ratio-of-arithmetic-means reduction and paired per-run reduction are distinct columns; Full pairs use (campaign stage, map, repeat)
definitions.cumulative_warning: Profile-window core-s is not whole-flight core-s; never multiply profile mean cores by mission/cgroup duration
definitions.summary_statistics: Sample SD (n-1), arithmetic mean, median, min/max, linearly interpolated p05/p95, sum and available n
definitions.residual: Uninstrumented executor/DDS/background threads, profiler overhead and separately running mission CPU are outside the additional subtotal; do not label the residual avoidable waste
definitions.renderer_role_warning: Whole renderer thread may execute nested acquisition/map/frontend handoff work. Role CPU is diagnostic and must not replace exclusive-stage ownership.
definitions.raw_in_window: True exactly when report monotonic timestamp is within min/max campaign_active telemetry timestamps; RAW CSV preserves records outside this interval too
definitions.role_in_window: Unavailable: role markers contain no monotonic timestamp. Raw line and source line are retained instead of inventing timing
